record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Find shift-monotone sequence ideals z(N0) for which the entropy-number generated operator ideal L^{ENT}_z carries non-vanishing singular traces.

evidence.quote:
Problem 18. Find shift-monotone sequence ideals z(N0) such that LENT
z
carries non-vanishing singular traces.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup.

(a) Let $\mathbb{N}_0=\{0,1,2,\dots\}$ and let $c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ denote the space of real (or complex) sequences $x=(\xi_k)_{k\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ converging to $0$. Let $S_+\colon c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)\to c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ denote the forward shift $(S_+x)_k=\xi_{k-1}$ for $k\ge 1$, $(S_+x)_0=0$, and let $S_-$ denote the backward shift $(S_-x)_k=\xi_{k+1}$. A linear subspace $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)\subseteq c_0(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is called a shift-monotone sequence ideal if it is invariant under both $S_+$ and $S_-$ and contains every sequence $y$ for which there exists $x\in\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $|y_k|\le |x_k|$ for all $k$.

(b) For a (bounded linear) operator $T\colon X\to Y$ between Banach spaces, the $n$-th (dyadic) entropy number $\varepsilon_n(T)$ is defined for $n\in\mathbb{N}_0$ as the infimum of those $\varepsilon>0$ such that the image $T(B_X)$ of the closed unit ball can be covered by $2^n$ closed balls of radius $\varepsilon$ in $Y$. Given a shift-monotone sequence ideal $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$, the entropy-generated operator ideal is
$$\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{ENT}}_{\mathfrak{z}}:=\bigl\{T\in\mathfrak{L}(X,Y):(\varepsilon_n(T))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}\in\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0),\ X,Y\ \text{Banach}\bigr\}.$$

(c) A trace on a two-sided operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}$ is a linear functional $\tau$ defined on the component $\mathfrak{A}(X,X)$ for each Banach space $X$ such that $\tau(ST)=\tau(TS)$ whenever the composition makes sense within $\mathfrak{A}$. A trace $\tau$ is called singular if it vanishes on every finite-rank operator. A trace is non-vanishing if it is not identically zero.

Problem. Characterize, or exhibit a rich family of, shift-monotone sequence ideals $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ for which the entropy-generated operator ideal $\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{ENT}}_{\mathfrak{z}}$ admits a non-vanishing singular trace.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in Pietsch's survey on traces on operator ideals defined over all Banach spaces. Related results exist on the existence of singular traces on simply-generated and approximation-number generated operator ideals on Hilbert space, but no published resolution for the entropy-generated case over arbitrary Banach spaces was found.

status_evidence.title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems regarding traces on operator ideals over Banach spaces, including questions on entropy-number generated ideals.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Existence of Singular Traces on Simply Generated Operator Ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of singular traces on simply generated operator ideals on Hilbert space.
status_evidence.claim: Related results exist for simply-generated ideals on Hilbert space but not for the entropy-generated ideals over Banach spaces.

status_evidence.title: The Spectrum of Shift Operators and the Existence of Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch's approach via shift-monotone sequence ideals and shift operators.
status_evidence.claim: Framework for traces via shift operators is developed, but the entropy-ideal case remains open.
